# Parameter
```{r}

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "NA",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}

# ---------- colors ----------
low_fill <- "#9DC3E6"
high_fill <- "#F3B082"

low_line <- "#4F81BD"
high_line <- "#D97742"

violin_alpha <- 0.3

# ---------- half-eye / raincloud ----------
violin_width <- 0.7
violin_linewidth <- 2
violin_alpha <- 0.2

density_adjust <- 1
density_trim <- FALSE
scale <- 0.45

# ---------- mean and errorbar ----------
mean_errorbar_linewidth <- 3
mean_errorbar_width <- 0.15

mean_point_size <- 10
mean_marker_shape <- 23
mean_marker_stroke <- 2

# ---------- position ----------
point_x_offset <- 0.08

# ---------- axis ----------
geomline_linewidth <- 1
axis_linewidth <- 1.2
axis_tick_linewidth <- 1.2

# ---------- significance ----------
sig_label_size <- 30

# ---------- plot margin ----------
plot_margin_top <- 10
plot_margin_right <- 20
plot_margin_bottom <- 10
plot_margin_left <- 20

# ---------- left axis: Gratitude ----------
left_y_min <- 0
left_y_max <- 75
left_y_breaks <- seq(0, 65, 20)

# ---------- right axis: Allocation ----------
right_y_min <- 0
right_y_max <- 8.5
right_y_breaks <- seq(0, 8, 2)

right_to_left <- function(x) {
  x / right_y_max * left_y_max
}

left_to_right <- function(x) {
  x / left_y_max * right_y_max
}

# ---------- significance label position ----------
sig_y_grati <- 70
sig_y_alloc <- left_to_right(sig_y_grati)

# ---------- convert p value to stars ----------
p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "NA",
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}

group_levels <- c(
  "EXP2-Grati-Bene",
  "EXP3-Grati-Bene",
  "EXP3-Grati-Cost",
  "EXP4-Alloc-Cost"
)

group_labels <- c(
  "EXP2-Grati-Bene" = "Exp2-",

  "EXP3-Grati-Cost" = "Exp3-",
  "EXP4-Alloc-Cost" = "Exp4-"
)

# 左轴对应的三个 Gratitude 实验
grati_groups <- c(
  "EXP2-Grati-Bene",
  "EXP3-Grati-Bene",
  "EXP3-Grati-Cost"
)

# 右轴对应的两个 Allocation 实验
alloc_groups <- c(
  "EXP4-Alloc-Cost"
)



```

```{r}

exp_data <- read_excel(data_file, sheet = 'alldata')
exp_data <- exp_data[exp_data$Situation == 'Uncertain', ]
exp_data$Outcome <- factor(exp_data$Outcome, levels = c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-8"))

```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# 6. Prepare plotting data
# ============================================================

plot_data <- exp_data %>%
  mutate(
    EXP_name = trimws(as.character(EXP_name)),

    # 设置实验顺序
    Group = factor(EXP_name, levels = group_levels),
    Group_num = as.numeric(Group),

    # 设置 Outcome 标签
    Outcome = factor(
      Outcome,
      levels = c("Outcome-2", "Outcome-8"),
      labels = c("Outcome2", "Outcome8")
    ),

    # 区分左轴和右轴
    Domain = case_when(
      EXP_name %in% grati_groups ~ "Gratitude",
      EXP_name %in% alloc_groups ~ "Allocation",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    # 关键：把 Allocation 映射到左轴尺度
    value_plot = case_when(
      Domain == "Gratitude"  ~ var_abs,
      Domain == "Allocation" ~ right_to_left(var_abs)
    ),

    # 每个实验内部左右分布
    # Outcome2 在左，Outcome8 在右
    x_pos = case_when(
      Outcome == "Outcome2" ~ Group_num - point_x_offset,
      Outcome == "Outcome8" ~ Group_num + point_x_offset
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Group),
    !is.na(Outcome),
    !is.na(var_abs),
    !is.na(Domain)
  )


# ============================================================
# 7. Summary data: mean and SE
# ============================================================

summary_long <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(Group, Group_num, Outcome, x_pos, Domain) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_raw = mean(var_abs, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_raw = sd(var_abs, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(var_abs))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # mean 映射到绘图尺度
    mean_plot = case_when(
      Domain == "Gratitude"  ~ mean_raw,
      Domain == "Allocation" ~ right_to_left(mean_raw)
    ),

    # errorbar 映射到绘图尺度
    ymin = case_when(
      Domain == "Gratitude"  ~ mean_raw - se_raw,
      Domain == "Allocation" ~ right_to_left(mean_raw - se_raw)
    ),
    ymax = case_when(
      Domain == "Gratitude"  ~ mean_raw + se_raw,
      Domain == "Allocation" ~ right_to_left(mean_raw + se_raw)
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 8. Paired t-test for each experiment
# ============================================================

sig_df <- plot_data %>%
  select(SubID, Group, Group_num, Outcome, var_abs, Domain) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Outcome,
    values_from = var_abs
  ) %>%
  group_by(Group, Group_num, Domain) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = t.test(
      Outcome2,
      Outcome8,
      paired = TRUE
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig = p_to_stars(p_value),

    # 显著性标注位置
    y_sig = case_when(
      Domain == "Gratitude"  ~ sig_y_grati,
      Domain == "Allocation" ~ right_to_left(sig_y_alloc)
    )
  )


```

# fig
```{r, fig.width = width_in_inches, fig.height = height_in_inches}

output_path <- ".\\02_fig\\02_allexps_var_ttest_260613.svg"

p <- ggplot() +

  # ---------- separator between Gratitude and Allocation ----------
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 3.5,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = geomline_linewidth,
    color = "grey50"
  ) +

  # ---------- Outcome2: left half-eye ----------
  stat_halfeye(
    data = plot_data %>% filter(Outcome == "Outcome2"),
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = value_plot
    ),
    fill = scales::alpha(low_fill, violin_alpha),
    slab_color = low_line,
    slab_linewidth = violin_linewidth,
    orientation = "vertical",
    side = "left",
    adjust = density_adjust,
    trim = density_trim,
    width = violin_width,
    scale = scale,
    .width = 0,
    point_interval = NULL
  ) +
  
  stat_halfeye(
    data = plot_data %>% filter(Outcome == "Outcome8"),
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = value_plot
    ),
    fill = scales::alpha(high_fill, violin_alpha),
    slab_color = high_line,
    slab_linewidth = violin_linewidth,
    orientation = "vertical",
    side = "right",
    adjust = density_adjust,
    trim = density_trim,
    width = violin_width,
    scale = scale,
    .width = 0,
    point_interval = NULL
  ) +

  # ---------- mean ± SE ----------
  geom_errorbar(
    data = summary_long,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      color = Outcome
    ),
    width = mean_errorbar_width,
    linewidth = mean_errorbar_linewidth
  ) +

  # ---------- mean point ----------
  geom_point(
    data = summary_long,
    aes(
      x = x_pos,
      y = mean_plot,
      fill = Outcome
    ),
    shape = mean_marker_shape,
    size = mean_point_size,
    color = "black",
    stroke = mean_marker_stroke
  ) +

  # ---------- significance stars ----------
  geom_text(
    data = sig_df,
    aes(
      x = Group_num,
      y = y_sig,
      label = sig
    ),
    size = sig_label_size,
    color = "black"
    # fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  # ---------- fill colors ----------
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Outcome2" = low_fill,
      "Outcome8" = high_fill
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Outcome2" = "Outcome-2",
      "Outcome8" = "Outcome-8"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  # ---------- line colors ----------
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Outcome2" = low_line,
      "Outcome8" = high_line
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Outcome2" = "Outcome-2",
      "Outcome8" = "Outcome-8"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  # ---------- x axis ----------
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    labels = group_labels[group_levels],
    limits = c(0.2, 4.8),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.0, 0.0))
  ) +

  # ---------- y axis with secondary axis ----------
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "|ΔGratitude|",
    limits = c(left_y_min, left_y_max),
    breaks = left_y_breaks,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.0, 0.0)),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~ left_to_right(.),
      name = "|ΔAllocation|",
      breaks = right_y_breaks
    )
  ) +

  # ---------- labels ----------
  labs(
    x = "Exp",
    fill = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  
  theme_pub() +
  theme(
  axis.title.y.right = element_text(
    margin = margin(l = title_margin)
  ),
  axis.text.y.right = element_text(margin = margin(l = text_margin)))

save_pub(p, output_path)

rm(p, summary_data)
gc()


```
